title: 第5章 吴百户第6章 青龙使孟望津
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
在藏宝阁中，力士们可以挑选适合自己的功法进行修炼，从而提升自己的实力。
这对于这些力士而言，无疑是一个千载难逢的机遇。
“对！
快去禀告给吴百户。”
万平连忙激动的说道。
江辰也知道事不宜迟，他看向众人头顶，对着两个罪恶值最高的锦衣卫说道：“你，还有你，跟我一起回去禀告吴百户其他人就地看守，不要让任何人接近。”
“好！”
江辰身形矫健，走出客栈，一跃跨上那匹原本属于李成器的骏马，马儿似乎感受到了这个人不是他的主人开始闹腾起来。
江辰冷哼一声，十三重龙象般若功的气息泄露出来，那恐怖如远古荒兽的气息立刻让它安静了下来。
“驾！”
随着一声呼喝，这匹骏马立刻四蹄翻腾，瞬间便带着江辰向着镇抚司疾驰而去。
大约一个时辰之后，马蹄声在镇抚司的门前缓缓停下，尘土飞扬中，江辰的身影显得格外挺拔。
这里，是锦衣卫的权力中心，也是他们这些下属汇报重要事务的地方。
“站住，干什么的？”
两名身着锦衣卫服饰的守卫，手持长枪，拦在了他们的面前，语气中带着不容置疑的威严。
他们的眼神在江辰等人身上扫过，显然看他们是小旗，根本不将他们放在眼里。
面对守卫的询问，江辰没有丝毫的犹豫，他从容地从怀中掏出自己的腰牌，高高举起，同时声音清晰而有力地回答道：“锦衣卫力士江辰，有紧急军情汇报。
锦衣卫总旗李成器暗通妖僧觉明，图谋不轨，请吴百户跟我等速速前往，以免延误时机！”
江辰的话语简短而有力，两句话便将事情的严重性阐述得淋漓尽致。
他的声音在镇抚司的门前回荡，引得周围的行人纷纷侧目。

而那两名守卫在听到“李成器”
与“妖僧觉明”
这两个名字时，脸色也是微微一变。
在短暂的沉默之后，其中一名守卫迅速转身，向着镇抚司内部跑去，显然是去通报吴百户了。
原本在堆满文案的房间里专注处理公务的吴百户，在听到属下禀报之后，脸色瞬间变得铁青。
仿佛被一阵寒风猛然吹过，手中的笔也不由自主地掉落在了桌上，发出“啪嗒”
一声轻响。
他猛地抬起头，双眼圆睁，嘴角紧抿，透露出难以置信之色。
他连忙大步走出镇抚司，厉声质问江辰：“你说什么！
李成器暗通妖僧觉明？！”
吴百户怒火中烧，他难以置信地重复了一遍江辰的话，仿佛要确认自己是否听错了。
要知道，李成器作为锦衣卫中的总旗，一直以来都是他眼中的忠诚之士，如今却突然被指控与妖僧觉明勾结，这让他如何能够接受？
江辰闻言，双手一抱拳，身体微微前倾，再次坚定地说道：“千真万确！
属下亲眼所见，李成器不仅与觉明有所勾结，还企图出卖锦衣卫换取魔教丹药。
content_en:
In the Treasure Pavilion, warriors can choose exercises that suit them and practice them to improve their strength.
This is undoubtedly a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for these warriors.
"Yes!
Go and report it to Wu Baihu quickly. "
Wan Ping said excitedly.
Jiang Chen also knew that it was too late. He looked above the heads of everyone and said to the two Jin Yiwei who had the highest crime value: "You, and you, go back with me and tell the others in Wu Baihu to guard the place and don't let anyone get close."
"Okay!"
With a strong figure, Jiang Chen walked out of the inn and jumped onto the horse that originally belonged to Li Chengqi. The horse seemed to sense that this man was not its owner and started to make a fuss.
Jiang Chen snorted coldly, and the aura of the thirteenth level Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung leaked out, and the terrifying aura like an ancient wild beast immediately silenced him.
"Drive!"
With a shout, the horse immediately flipped its hooves, and in an instant it took Jiang Chen and galloped towards the Zhenfu Division.
About an hour later, the sound of horse hooves slowly stopped in front of Zhenfusi's door. Amid the flying dust, Jiang Chen's figure looked particularly tall and straight.
This is the center of power of Jinyiwei, and it is also the place where their subordinates report important matters.
"Stop, what are you doing?"
Two guards dressed in brocade uniforms, holding long spears, stopped in front of them, with undoubted majesty in their tone.
Their eyes swept over Jiang Chen and others, and they obviously saw them as Xiaoqi and did not take them seriously at all.
Facing the guard's inquiry, Jiang Chen didn't hesitate at all. He calmly took out his badge from his arms, held it up high, and answered in a clear and powerful voice: "Jinyi Guardsman Jiang Chen has an urgent military intelligence report.
Li Chengqi, the bannerman of Jinyiwei, has secretly communicated with the demon monk Jueming and has evil intentions. Please Wu Baihu and follow me to go there quickly to avoid delaying the opportunity! "
Jiang Chen's words were short and powerful, and the seriousness of the matter was clearly explained in two sentences.
His voice echoed in front of Zhenfusi's door, attracting side glances from the passers-by around him.
And when the two guards heard "Li Chengqi"
and "Monk Jueming"
When he heard these two names, his expression also changed slightly.
After a brief silence, one of the guards quickly turned around and ran towards the interior of the Zhenfu Division, apparently to inform Wu Baihu.
Wu Baihu, who was originally focused on handling official duties in a room full of papers, turned pale in an instant after hearing the report from his subordinates.
As if being suddenly blown by a gust of cold wind, the pen in his hand fell on the table involuntarily, making a "crack" sound.
A soft sound.
He raised his head suddenly, his eyes widened, and his mouth tightened, revealing a look of disbelief.
He quickly strode out of the Zhenfu Division and asked Jiang Chen sternly: "What did you say!
Li Chengqi secretly communicated with the demon monk Jueming? ! "
Wu Baihu was furious. He repeated Jiang Chen's words in disbelief, as if to confirm whether he heard correctly.
You know, Li Chengqi, as the general banner of the Imperial Guard, has always been a loyal person in his eyes, but now he is suddenly accused of colluding with the demon monk Jueming. How can he accept this?
Hearing this, Jiang Chen cupped his hands into fists, leaned forward slightly, and said firmly again: "It's absolutely true!
His subordinates saw with their own eyes that Li Chengqi not only colluded with Jueming, but also attempted to betray Jin Yiwei in exchange for the demon sect's elixir.
